author: Yffe
content: Fix the byteview dispatch (and the generated-def emission gates) to key on the callee's PARAM SHAPE, not its NAME. A user spec fn declaring &String/String shadows any generated def of that name: exclude such names from callee_takes_string_byteview AND from program_uses_parse/_numfmt/_string_search so a user is_digit(&String) passes the &TString ref and does not materialize the generated is_digit(u8). Single file: thermite-lower/src/lower.rs. Un-ignore the pin and run the full gauntlet with real verus.
